key_insight: Molmo2 provides an open-weight, openly documented vision–language model and dataset focused on video understanding and spatial–temporal grounding, closing the gap between proprietary VLMs and the open-source community.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of fully open, reproducible video-language models and training data—existing top open models either distill from proprietary systems or hide their data/recipes, preventing transparent progress on video understanding and grounding.
method: Release of a fully open training stack: published model weights, curated training data, and a reproducible recipe for training video+image language models.

Multi-task training on video and image data combining contrastive alignment, captioning, and explicit grounding/localization objectives to learn both high-level semantics and spatial‑temporal localization.

Model architecture that fuses a video-capable encoder with a grounding head (cross-attention between text and spatio-temporal features) to produce localized predictions (boxes/timestamps) and language outputs.
impact: Provides a transparent, reproducible foundation for building and evaluating video-language systems with grounding, enabling researchers and practitioners to fine-tune, audit, and extend strong VLMs without relying on proprietary models or hidden data.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: video encoder + cross-attention grounding head -> outputs (caption, localized boxes/timestamps).
Dataset composition chart: breakdown of open video, image, and grounding supervision sources and sizes.
Example grounding visualizations: video frames with predicted bounding boxes/time spans and generated captions.
Bar chart or table: performance comparison (accuracy/grounding metrics) vs prior open and proprietary baselines, plus a badge showing 'open weights & data'.
paper_title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
paper_authors: Christopher Clark, Jieyu Zhang, Zixian Ma, Jae Sung Park, Mohammadreza Salehi
